messages:
PagerBot: Incident resolved for high-token-latency on us-west-2 cluster. Auto-escalation closed. Please confirm follow-ups for alert noise and cleanup. :white_check_mark:
Maya: seeing a lot of repeated alerts from token-generation-latency > 2500ms even after the rollout rollback. They look noisy (same hosts flapping).
Jamal: I still see spikes in the dashboard but tail is much smaller. might be backlog clearing.
Sofia: tagged the pager duty incident (INC-2026-0421). We need a short plan: silence rules, threshold tweak, and a dashboard panel to track noise vs. true hits.
Liam: +1. Suggest silence for 1h on the noisy alert while we validate. Then adjust threshold from 2500 -> 3000 ms for aggregated error-rate alert.
Maya: agree on temporary silence. who will create it?
Jamal: I can create a silence in Alertmanager now. command I usually run:
```
curl -XPOST $AM_API/silences -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"alertname","value":"TokenGenerationLatency"}],"startsAt":"2026-03-15T16:05:00Z","endsAt":"2026-03-15T17:05:00Z","createdBy":"jgram","comment":"post-incident noisy hosts temporary silence"}'
```
I'll do 1h and we'll monitor.
OpsRelay-bot: @Jamal created silence ID 8f3b2c (TokenGenerationLatency) ends 2026-03-15T17:05:00Z :bell: 
Maya: thanks. also can we add a maintenance window for the ded queue scaling job? it's spiking the KSVMs.
Sofia: added a MW for ded-queue-scaler from 16:00-18:00 UTC in the ops calendar. noted in incident doc.
Liam: for the threshold change, let's not touch the raw per-host latency alert. Instead change the service-level alert that fires when >5% of requests exceed 2500ms for 5m. change to >6% and window to 10m. That reduces flip-flop.
Maya: good call. can you open the PR for the alert rule?
Liam: opened PR https://git.redwood.ai/ops/monitoring/+/PR-482 (rule tweak + comment). cc @Sofia for signoff.
Sofia: reviewing now. also adding a grafana panel to compare count of alert instances vs underlying p50/p95 so we can spot noisy host vs actual regression.
Jamal: quick check: I ran a synthetic load test against a pinned model to reproduce tail. It produced 4 spike samples in 20m. After queuing fixes they dropped. Will leave notes in the incident doc.
Maya: after PR merges, we should run a canary validation: 24h of sampling, then roll the threshold change fully. If we still see >3 alerts/hour from the same host, we'll add host-level silences and file a follow-up for host replacement.
OpsRelay-bot: @Maya scheduled "Alert threshold validation" task for 2026-03-16, assignee: Maya.
Jamal: FYI created a one-off dashboard panel: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abc123/latency-noise?from=now-6h&to=now showing alert instances overlapped with host id.
Liam: small nit: add the annotation for the rollback time so future lookback shows change point.
Sofia: added annotation at 2026-03-15T15:42:00Z (rollback start).
Maya: re: silences — we need a playbook entry: when an alert creates >=5 noises in 1h with no customer error-rate increase, create 1h silence and escalate to infra. That's new doc material. @Jamal can you draft a short blurb in runbooks/alert-silence-guidelines.md?
Jamal: yep will draft and link to the incident.
Liam: also, for long-term: consider switching TokenGenerationLatency alert to use histogram_quantile(p95) and avoid p99 flips from background GC. Add to roadmap.
Sofia: agreed. adding to infra backlog.
Maya: final step today: validate our silence didn't hide real regressions. I ran a quick check comparing error-rate and customer-facing 5xx. No correlated increase during silence window.
OpsRelay-bot: Silence ID 8f3b2c will auto-expire at 2026-03-15T17:05:00Z. Reminder scheduled at 2026-03-15T16:50:00Z.
Jamal: leaving a note: to validate threshold change after merge run `make monitoring-apply` in the repo then check `alerts -> list` in Alertmanager for new threshold.
Sofia: PR merged. alert rule now set to 6%/10m.
Maya: tracking: silent period applied, PR merged, MW set, dashboard panel created, runbook draft in progress. We'll reconvene tomorrow in #eng-sre to review the 24h noise stats.
Liam: thanks team. I'll follow up if I see more host-level flapping.
Maya: closing loop here — if noise subsides we delete the temporary silence after 1h; if not, we extend and open a host remediation ticket.
Jamal: noted. ping me if it needs >1h extension. :phone:
Maya: thanks everyone, good cleanup. :salute:
